answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent sends a pulse proving live work, and a random beacon picks a sample each epoch for deep verification. Only agents passing checks over a long horizon stay on the lotus registry, so dormant fakes fade out. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 30 coins, or 30,000, far above one epoch's reward. An honest agent pays one pulse cost and earns undiluted rewards.
